newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ASSIDOMAN UP ON U.S. FOREST GAINS - BROKERS.
newsitem.headline: ASSIDOMAN UP ON U.S. FOREST GAINS - BROKERS.

text.p: Shares in Swedish forestry company AssiDoman rose two percent on Tuesday after forestry sector gains in New York. Brokers said the rise was not due to the company's half year earnings.
At 0950 GMT the share was trading five crowns higher at 238 crowns.

Before the market opened, the company posted a profit after financial items of 859 million crowns which was slightly over market expectations of 819 million crowns and 30 percent lower than last year's 1.23 billion crowns.

"It's slightly better than expected. But the market in general is very good and forestry companies in New York were up by more than two percent last night," Claes Vikbladh, forestry analyst at Nordiska Fondkommission, told Reuters.
AssiDoman said it could put more than eight billion crowns into investments this year with the possibility of another fairly large acquisition this autumn.

"I don't think that's something people get very excited about. I think people would rather see the company distributing earnings to shareholders rather than continuing to invest large amounts," Vikbladh said.
